entries.name: Shecan
entries.notes: Free tier. Documented support for Google AI/Gemini, Steam, Apple, Docker.

entries.name: 403.online
entries.notes: Private-range addresses: works only on Iranian ISP connections. DoH/DoT supported.

entries.name: Radar Game
entries.notes: Gaming-focused (National Computer Games Foundation). Private-range: Iranian ISPs only.

entries.name: Electro
entries.notes: Top pick for PSN/Xbox/launchers per community tests.

entries.name: Electro (new)
entries.notes: Newer published address set for Electro (stable ping for EA/FC 26).

entries.name: Begzar
entries.notes: General anti-sanction DNS, good complement for launchers.

entries.name: Pishgaman
entries.notes: Console/community favorite. Only reachable from within Iranian networks.

entries.name: Shatel
entries.notes: Only recommended for Shatel ISP subscribers.

entries.name: Vanilla
entries.notes: Gaming DNS. Private-range: Iranian ISPs only.

entries.name: Google Public DNS
entries.notes: Baseline for stability and downloads; does NOT bypass sanctions.

entries.name: Cloudflare
entries.notes: Fastest anycast resolver; does NOT bypass sanctions.

entries.name: Cloudflare Families (malware)
entries.notes: Blocks malware domains; use 1.1.1.3/1.0.0.3 for adult-content blocking too.

entries.name: Quad9
entries.notes: Swiss no-log policy, blocks malicious domains.

entries.name: OpenDNS (Cisco)
entries.notes: Long-standing stable resolver.

entries.name: Verisign
entries.notes: Operates .com/.net root infrastructure.

entries.name: AdGuard DNS
entries.notes: Blocks ads and trackers at DNS level.

entries.name: Control D
entries.notes: Unfiltered 'p0' anycast endpoints.

entries.name: Comodo Secure
entries.notes: Security-filtered SECURE DNS by Comodo.

entries.name: Neustar UltraDNS
entries.notes: Sometimes recommended for lower packet loss.

entries.name: Hurricane Electric
entries.notes: Single anycast IP from HE in Houston.

entries.name: Yandex
entries.notes: Geo-close alternative for some Iranian routes.

entries.name: NTT
entries.notes: Suggested in Iranian gaming guides as a download/latency alternative.

entries.name: CleanBrowsing (security)
entries.notes: Malware/adult content blocking profile.
